title: Video settings UI classification metadata
description: The Sankey dataset is the per-field classification source of truth for resetTier, displayScope, settingClass, and field path. This document defines the dimensions and UI interpretation; reset tiers are informed hypotheses for the stated custom DX12 engine using NVIDIA Streamline, DLSS 4.5, and FidelityFX/FSR4, not verified engine behavior.

labels.Tier 1 - Full Reset: Likely display, swapchain, session, or renderer reconfiguration; verify in engine.
labels.Tier 2 - Quick Reallocation: Likely targeted resource or feature reconfiguration; may hitch; verify in engine.
labels.Tier 3 - Free: Likely runtime parameter/update; not a guarantee of zero cost.

displayScope.note: Scopes describe the proposed UI placement, not necessarily exclusive applicability. General settings may apply to multiple display modes.

editableAt.note: The current Sankey dataset is scoped to in-menu settings; editability is intentionally not encoded there.

livePreview.note: Needs engine validation. A runtime-changeable value is not automatically suitable for split-screen/before-after preview.

recommendedRuntimePolicy: Derive user-facing apply behavior from observed engine apply results where possible. Keep hypotheses separate from verified requiresReinit behavior.
